en: Hm! If you want past here, you'll have to beat me and my Roggenrola. We're as sturdy as rock!
But my Roggenrola and I only battle strong Trainers. Can you break our rock-hard will?
Hm! Your strength is the real thing! My Roggenrola and I must become sturdier still. We're off to train. Farewell!
A great boulder blocks the way. It doesn't look as if any Pokémon could move it...
It's a great boulder... Use the Colress Machine on it?
{player} switched on the Colress Machine! It hums, and the boulder begins to shake...
It wasn't a boulder at all! A Crustle was sleeping in its rock!
The Colress Machine gave a pop and a puff of smoke. It's broken...
